remarks: Beautiful, Manhattan-style 1BR apartment in amazing in-town location! Set above the treetops on the 9th floor with sweeping views of the city, the floor plan is open for easy living and entertaining. Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite counters and breakfast bar opening to the living room. Bamboo floors in the living area. Balcony runs the full width of the apartment, perfect for dining al fresco, entertaining, or stargazing. Other features include in-unit washer/dryer and 1 garage parking space (#30 and half of #29). Luxury building with 24/7 concierge, rooftop pool, fitness center, and grills and picnic tables on the 3rd floor. Walk to shops, restaurants, theater, and all that vibrant Downtown Stamford has to offer! Excellent financials required. First month's rent and 2 months security.
